thread:
Sam (Sales): Marigold Finance signed this morning. Dedicated pool + Hosted fallback. Need a quick handoff: go-live target 4/12, SSO + VPC peering required, customer expects low latency for embeddings.

Julie (CS): Thanks — taking ownership of onboarding. Can someone paste the sales notes and the expected qps + peak window? Also flagging renewal watch: they requested data residency guarantees (EU only) which could be a contract caveat.

Sam (Sales): Notes: ARR $180k yr1, primary contacts: alicia@marigold.co (POC), raj@marigold.co (infra). Expected steady qps ~20rps, peak 60rps for batch jobs. They want EU region + dedicated GPU for production. Link to pitch doc: https://drive.redwood/marigold-sales-notes

Marta (Enablement): I'll own enablement sessions. Propose 2 sessions: 1) admin & SSO walkthrough (30m), 2) prompt engineering & evals (45m). Need sample prompts + eval set from Marigold by EOD next Tue. Can CS share?

Julie (CS): @Sam can you request sample prompts & a PO for provisioning? I'll send kickoff calendar when we have SAML metadata + IP ranges. Missing items list: 1) SAML metadata file, 2) VPC CIDR + peering contact, 3) KMS key policy if customer using their KMS, 4) model variants they expect to use (embedding vs chat).

Ben (Eng): I'll need a clear scope ticket for Private + Dedicated. Please create ENG- ticket with the following fields: customer, vpc_peering_required (yes/no), sso_type (SAML), kms_integration (yes/no), expected_qps, latency_slo. Also include their test dataset size for performance tuning.

Sam (Sales): Creating tickets now. SUP-4321 created for provisioning request -> contains customer contact + provisional timeline. ENG-2106 created for infra work (VPC peering, KMS). I added sales notes and contract excerpts.

deploy_bot: Scheduled: provisional capacity reservation for Marigold on 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC. Reservation ID: res-78b2.

Marta (Enablement): For enablement content, please upload 10 representative prompts + 20 eval pairs to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/marigold-evals. I'll build the playbook and run a quick eval pass.

Julie (CS): Owners & next steps: Julie -> onboarding/runbook + customer comms; Marta -> enablement sessions + evals; Ben -> eng ticket ENG-2106, infra validation; Sam -> ensure Marigold delivers SAML metadata + prompts; Support -> SUP-4321 tracks provisioning.

Ben (Eng): Quick ask: send SAML metadata in metadata.xml and the IdP entity ID. If they use SHA-256 signatures, call that out. Example snippet we need pasted in ENG ticket:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.marigold.co">
  <!-- metadata file here -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Julie (CS): I'll schedule kickoff for 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC and invite Marigold + owners. If any blockers before that (SSO or VPC), escalate to eng on-call. Adding stale-risk: if SAML or peering not ready by 3/29, go-live may slip; mark renewal-watch in CRM and flag legal re: EU residency clause.

Sam (Sales): Noted. I'll nudge Marigold for metadata + prompts today.

Julie (CS): Final check: does anyone need additional access to the customer's cloud team for peering? If yes, list contacts and I'll coordinate the NDA/POC call.

Ben (Eng): Add raj@marigold.co and network@marigold.co to the ENG ticket. We'll request a one-hour window next week for peering test.

Marta (Enablement): Thanks team — I'll draft the session invites and a short pre-kickoff survey for Marigold to capture priority features and top failure modes.

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: Good handoff. Julie I'll follow-up in CRM notes once I confirm prompts.

Julie (CS): Closing note: I'll post a short onboarding runbook in #cs-playbooks after kickoff and link tickets. Everyone: react with :white_check_mark: when you have completed your action items.
